evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label, updates src/crypto/sha256 and ECC initialization in src/common/, and integrates hardware SHA256 into libsecp256k1 contexts.
rationale: Plugging Bitcoin Core's hardware SHA256 implementation into libsecp256k1 provides measurable performance improvements for cryptographic signing. Benchmarks show ECDSA signing improves by ~13–15% and Schnorr signing by ~3–7% on CPUs with SHA extensions, while cleanly structuring the ECC context lifecycle across the codebase.
